headline: Assaí Approves Share Buyback Program of Up to 11 Million Shares
summary: Brazilian retailer Assaí approved a share buyback program covering up to 11 million shares to be held in treasury for subsequent sale or cancellation.
why: Share repurchase authorizations signal management's view on valuation and can provide structural support for a company's equity price.

impacts.name: Sendas Distribuidora S.A.
impacts.why: Share buyback programs reduce share count and can support equity valuations.
